benefit_conditions: Welcome Benefit is applicable on 1st Transaction done within 30 days of card issuance and will be available to claim inside Tata Neu App within 60 days of such transaction
For eligible customers, option to claim the Welcome Benefit will be available inside Tata Neu App for 180 days from statement date of the eligible transaction
The validity of the NeuCoins given against Welcome Benefit will be 365 days from the claim date
W.e.f 10-Jun-2025, Domestic Lounge Access benefit will be Milestone based and can be availed as a Lounge Voucher on spends of Rs 50,000 or more in a calendar quarter.
Complimentary lounge access on direct swipe-off is discontinued effective midnight of 09-Jun-2025 23:59:59hrs.
To use the Participating Airport Lounge, customer's must be validated at point of entry by sharing voucher details with the lounge operator.
The voucher can only be used by the person whose name is stated at the top of their voucher. Proof of identification will be required to gain entry.
The offer is not transferable, non-negotiable and cannot be encashed
Bank has sole and absolute discretion- may alter, cancel, or amend eligibility of any credit card, or card feature/benefits, at any time without prior notice.

Please note that additional charge may occur for meal/food/drink items (especially Alcoholic Drinks) as well as for services like Nap, Massage Service and Spa as per the discretion of the Participating Airport Lounge.

Participating Airport Lounges may reserve the right to enforce a maximum stay policy (usually 2 - 3 hours) to prevent overcrowding. This is at the discretion of the individual Lounge operator who may impose a charge for extended stays
HDFC Bank shall not be liable under any circumstances for the services provided at and by the Participating Lounges.
Additional 5% NeuCoins on selected categories require downloading Tata Neu App, registering for NeuPass, and using primary card holder mobile number
UPI extra 0.75% NeuCoins requires using Tata Neu UPI ID
If your card is upgraded, lost, or reissued, spends done on only new card will be considered. Spends done on previous card will not be considered for qualification.
The Net spends (Debits / Purchases minus Credit / reversals), will be considered as per the posting date (settlement date).

Reversal of transactions of previous calendar quarter will be treated as per following example: In case the transaction was done in period Jan-Mar, but the reversal of the same transaction comes in period Apr-Jun (another quarter), then the reversal will be considered and deducted in period Apr-Jun spends calculation and so-on.
In case of EMI transactions, only the Principal Amount Billed with Monthly EMI will be considered.

important_terms: NeuCoins earned on your Tata Neu HDFC Bank Credit Card will have a validity of 12 months (including lock period) from the end of the month in which they're credited to your Tata Neu Account.

Non-Promotional NeuCoins: The validity of your existing balance of Non-Promotional NeuCoins (earned before 01-Aug-25) will be set as 31-Jul-26 in your Tata Neu Account, this activity will start from Jul’25 and will be completed by Aug’25 in a phased manner.
Promotional NeuCoins/Welcome Benefit: NeuCoins earned during special promotions or as Welcome Benefit will continue to follow the expiry terms communicated at the time of issuance.
